name: Self Importance
overview: Scripture warns against the dangers of self-importance, highlighting that pride leads to shame and destruction, as seen in Proverbs 11:2 and 16:18. The fall of Lucifer in Isaiah 14:12 exemplifies the catastrophic consequences of a haughty spirit. True wisdom and blessing come from humility and walking in godly counsel rather than aligning with the ungodly, as Psalms 1:1 teaches. Ultimately, God's love through Christ, demonstrated in John 3:16, calls believers away from self-exaltation to a life centered on Him.
